Nested data frame with one row per league year covered by the contract, breaking cap and cash figures down by year. Its columns are documented below with the season_history$ prefix. A final row labelled "Total" carries contract-level totals
League year for the row. The final row is labelled "Total" and holds contract totals rather than a single year
Team for that league year ("Total" on the totals row)
Base salary for the league year, in millions of dollars
Prorated signing bonus charged to the salary cap that league year, in millions of dollars
Prorated option bonus charged to the salary cap that league year, in millions of dollars
Roster bonus for the league year, in millions of dollars
Portion of the league year's salary that is guaranteed, in millions of dollars
Total salary cap charge for the league year, in millions of dollars
cap_number as a share of that league year's salary cap
Cash paid to the player in the league year, in millions of dollars
Workout bonus for the league year, in millions of dollars (NA when not applicable)
Per-game roster bonus for the league year, in millions of dollars (NA when not applicable)
Any other bonus for the league year, in millions of dollars (NA when not applicable)

Nested data frame with one row per contract in the player's OverTheCap contract history (drafted deals, extensions, franchise tags, etc.). Its columns are documented below with the contract_history$ prefix
Team on that contract
How the contract was acquired, e.g. "Drafted", "Extension", "UFA", "RFA", "ERFA", "Franchise", "Transition", "UDFA", "SFA", "Practice", "Other"
Status of that contract, e.g. "Active", "Expired", "Extended", "Terminated", "Traded", "Retired", "Renegotiated", "Claimed", "Elevated", "Reserve", "Inactive", "June 1 Terminated", "Deceased"
Year that contract was signed
Length of that contract in years
Total value of that contract, in millions of dollars
Average money per year of that contract, in millions of dollars
Total guaranteed money on that contract, in millions of dollars
Money the player has actually earned on that contract to date, in millions of dollars
Share of the contract's total value that has been earned to date
Average money per year of that contract once actual earnings are accounted for, in millions of dollars
